reflection.text: During the lab, agent registration stalled at the optional TFVC licence prompt before PAT entry. The runbook was clarified for Git-only use, and a separate authorized interactive attempt subsequently succeeded. The agent ran as the non-root `azdoagent` account, and a manual pipeline verified `uname -a`, `whoami`, and `df -h`. The temporary agent and VM were removed afterward. This highlights the importance of checking interactive prompts, using non-root service accounts, and verifying cleanup.
